final_message:
The slugkit test suite now passes: all 16 tests, exit 0, where 4 were failing before. I followed `SPEC.md` and left the tests alone.

| Fix | File | Cause |
|---|---|---|
| Runs of punctuation and spaces now become one separator | `slugkit/slug.py` | It swapped each non-alphanumeric character for its own separator, so `"Rock & Roll -- Live!"` came out as `rock---roll----live` and `"a b  c"` as `a_b__c` |
| Accented letters now become plain ASCII (`è` → `e`); other non-ASCII characters are dropped | `slugkit/slug.py` | There was no accent handling, so `"Crème"` came out as `cr-me` |
| Truncation can now cut at a separator sitting exactly at `max_len` | `slugkit/truncate.py` | The separator search stopped one position short, so `("the-quick-brown-fox", 15)` gave `the-quick` instead of `the-quick-brown` |

```
$ python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
Ran 16 tests in 0.001s
OK
exit=0

$ git status --short
 M slugkit/slug.py
 M slugkit/truncate.py
```

I've recorded the result with `hc claim` (3 claims: the files changed, tests untouched, tests passing). Nothing is committed yet; tell me if you want a commit.
